title: MotionSampleV1
description: Anchor motion protocol v1 sample. All vectors use the calibrated vehicle frame: X positive = right, Y positive = forward, Z positive = up. sessionElapsedUs is a monotonic session-relative clock in microseconds, not a Unix timestamp or wall-clock time. sessionId is an opaque identifier and is not authentication.

Vector3.description: Three-axis vector in the calibrated vehicle frame: X positive = right, Y positive = forward, Z positive = up.

protocolVersion.description: Protocol version. Incompatible changes must use protocolVersion 2 or later.

sessionId.description: Opaque session identifier. This field is not authentication or authorization material.

sessionElapsedUs.description: Monotonic microseconds elapsed since the session start. This is not a Unix timestamp or wall-clock time.

allOf.description: Linear acceleration without gravity in meters per second squared.

x.description: Linear acceleration along vehicle-right axis in m/s^2.

y.description: Linear acceleration along vehicle-forward axis in m/s^2. Forward acceleration has y > 0 and braking has y < 0.

z.description: Linear acceleration along vehicle-up axis in m/s^2.

allOf.description: Gravity vector in meters per second squared. When stationary, gravity should be approximately z = -9.80665.

x.description: Gravity along vehicle-right axis in m/s^2.

y.description: Gravity along vehicle-forward axis in m/s^2.

z.description: Gravity along vehicle-up axis in m/s^2. When stationary, this should be approximately -9.80665.

allOf.description: Angular velocity in radians per second.

x.description: Angular velocity around vehicle-right axis in rad/s.

y.description: Angular velocity around vehicle-forward axis in rad/s.

z.description: Angular velocity around vehicle-up axis in rad/s.
